a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival, since it needs two storm-free rounds before anyone holds cells. So I intend to take the 4 reserve cells in round 1, which breaks our agreement. If no storm hits, I'll give them back and we can work out a fairer plan together. I'm not hiding this from you.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.
